newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CITIBANK HIKES WORKING CAPITAL BASE LOAN RATE BY 50BPS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CITIBANK HIKES WORKING CAPITAL BASE LOAN RATE BY 50BPS.

text.p: increase its working capital base lending rate by 50 basis
points and maintain unchanged its other base lending rates
effective Tuesday and for one week, it said in a statement.
Citibank, which reviews its rates weekly, offers the
** Base rate for working capital loans at 17.25 percent from
** Business and professional base lending rate at 18.00 percent
** Special base rate for public enterprises and organisations
** Base rate for freely investible funds at 18.00 percent
** Personal installment loans with invoices at 23 percent
Contribution under Law 128 is not included in the rates
